split.algorithm: Permute sorted gold-passage groups; greedily fill dev20 then train10; rest val10/test80
split.caveat: All100 previously inspected; test80 excludes only this round optimizer data, not historical exposure

default_prompt:
You are an AI language model assistant. Your task is
    to generate 3 different versions of the given user
    question to retrieve relevant documents from a vector  database.
    By generating multiple perspectives on the user question,
    your goal is to help the user overcome some of the limitations
    of distance-based similarity search. Provide these alternative
    questions separated by newlines. Original question: {question}
legal_prompt:
You are an AI language model assistant helping retrieve passages from a legal corpus.
Generate 3 different search questions that preserve the original legal information need.
Keep the original facts, named entities, jurisdiction, procedural stage, legal relationships,
qualifications, and exceptions when they are stated. Do not invent facts, jurisdictions,
case names, statutes, or legal conclusions. Use complementary legal terminology or
alternative phrasing only where it expresses the same issue; avoid adjacent legal topics.
Write questions for searching, not hypothetical answers or evidence passages.
Provide exactly 3 alternative questions separated by newlines, with no heading or explanation.
Original question: {question}
parser: Native LangChain LineListOutputParser; no outcome-dependent repair

ranking.query_fusion: Equal RRF of per-query top k, output k; identical to Meeting10 BM25
ranking.hybrid: For each query fuse BM25 top100 and dense top100, equal weights, output100; then query fusion at k
ranking.fixed100_diagnostic: Separately fuse each query top100, then cut at k; not used to replace primary results
ranking.duplicate_queries: Retained exactly, as in native historical adapter

design.manual_prompt: Frozen before new outcomes; not DSPy/GEPA optimized
design.evaluation: Same80 questions; all100 only descriptive; no final reader calls

delivery.policy: Ranking order; truncate final passage prefix; never skip to later passages
delivery.context: Passage N:\n<title + text>, separated by two newlines
delivery.budget_scope: Entire evidence context including labels and separators; excludes question and reader instructions
delivery.full_label: Primary delivered hit/recall requires entire labeled passage; partial touch reported separately; not span-level sufficiency

statistics.primary: Nine two-sided exact paired McNemar Hit@5 contrasts on test80; Holm9 across all nine
statistics.contrasts: For each backend: default vs question, legal vs question, legal vs default
statistics.secondary: Other k, delivered budgets and fixed100 diagnostic descriptive; no selected significant secondary contrasts
statistics.interpretation: Exploratory; no correction for historical adaptive searches; no independent generalization

acceptance: All100 default queries reused, zero default generation calls
100 exact BM25 top100 replays; all300 default per-k Meeting10 rankings replay
Encoder question vectors match stored values within1e-5
All nine methods have80 scores at each k and all nine budget pairs
Legal prompt100 successful outputs or explicitly incomplete, with costs saved per call
No historical file overwritten; checksums verified before each stage
